label: Applied Foucauldian power/knowledge critique to cultural anthropology of emotion and empire
description: Drawing on Foucault’s analytics of power and resistance, Abu-Lughod exposed how sentimental human-rights discourses justify imperial intervention in Muslim societies.
dialecticalTension: Replaces cultural essentialism with genealogies of power and embodied discourse.

label: Extended critique of Orientalist veil tropes into ethnographic analysis of Bedouin affect and geopolitics
description: Building on Mernissi’s deconstruction of Western fantasies of the veil, Abu-Lughod documented how Arab women express agency through poetry, kinship, and everyday politics.
dialecticalTension: Shifts focus from textual history to lived ethnographic poetics of emotion.

label: Mentored postcolonial critique of liberal-feminist agency and Western rescue narratives
description: Abu-Lughod’s critique of romanticizing resistance and colonial rescue narratives deeply shaped Mahmood’s landmark rethinking of agency in Politics of Piety.
dialecticalTension: Bridges cultural psychology of sentiment to postcolonial ethics of piety.
